title: UTDR Music Pack
description: This resourcepack adds some undertale and deltarune music to minecraft which can be played using /playsound command.
body:
This resourcepack adds some music from undertale/deltarune for you to play in game by using /playsound command such as /playsound undertale:ruins or /playsound deltarune:big_shot .  
Disclaimer:      

This is an unofficial fan-made Minecraft resource pack created for personal and non-commercial use. It contains music originally composed by Toby Fox for UNDERTALE and DELTARUNE. Some tracks may have been edited, looped, slowed down, sped up, or combined for use in Minecraft.    

I do not own UNDERTALE, DELTARUNE, Toby Fox’s music, or any related copyrights, trademarks, characters, or intellectual property. All rights belong to their respective owners. This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or approved by Toby Fox, UNDERTALE, DELTARUNE, Mojang, Microsoft, or any related parties.    

This resource pack is distributed for free, with no monetization enabled. No copyright infringement is intended. The purpose of this pack is only to help players apply these tracks conveniently in their own Minecraft gameplay.    

If you are a rights holder or authorized representative and believe that any content in this project infringes your rights, please contact me immediately. I will remove the affected content or take down the project as soon as possible upon request.
